items.title: Local variable type inference
items.text: A variable has a declared type and a scope. Initialize local variables before reading them; fields have defined default values, but relying on defaults can hide missing business logic.

items.title: Text blocks
items.text: String values are immutable sequences of text. Use value equality for text content, understand Unicode code points for international text, and prefer StringBuilder for repeated concatenation in loops.

items.title: Switch expressions
items.text: Control flow decides which statements run and how often. Make conditions precise, set clear loop termination conditions, and test zero/one/many-item boundaries to catch off-by-one errors.

items.title: Records and sealed classes
items.text: A class defines state and behavior; an object is an instance. Encapsulation protects invariants by keeping mutable state private and validating updates through a small public API.

items.title: Pattern matching
items.text: Modern Java features can make data modeling and branching clearer. Check the release baseline for each feature and keep preview-only syntax out of the stable core examples.

items.title: Distinguishing standardized features from previews
items.text: Check the language/API version, source and target settings, dependency compatibility, and official release notes. A preview feature requires the matching JDK and preview flags and is not a stable production contract.

content_blocks.title: Professional habit
content_blocks.text: Keep one clear hypothesis per experiment. Check the version, read the error message, test boundaries, and record what evidence supports your conclusion.
